mechanism_narrative: The sharp concurrent declines in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicate weakening daytime travel and commuting, which reduces incidental shopping trips and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not stay below its prior 4-week mean over the next 28 days despite continued week-on-week declines in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL rises above 15 points for two consecutive weeks, more at-home time suppresses discretionary in-person shopping, pushing RETAIL_REC lower within the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises > 15 points for 2 consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or remains unchanged over the next 14 days after RESIDENTIAL stays above the stated threshold for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous fall in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES intensifies the commuter-demand shock; when both move down together, retail visits weaken more than either series alone would imply, yielding lower RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline faster when both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES fall in the same week than when only one of them falls.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM drops below -20 while RETAIL_REC is already falling, the pattern reflects broad demand suppression rather than substitution into essentials, and retail-and-recreation mobility will continue to fall over the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -20 points while RETAIL_REC is already declining
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rebounds within 7 days after GROCERY_PHARM crosses below -20 and remains there.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained downturn in PARKS signals worse weather or fewer outdoor activity opportunities, which spills over into less discretionary out-of-home activity and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days even though PARKS stays below its current 4-week average.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime where RESIDENTIAL is rising while TRANSIT is falling, home-centered substitution dominates and retail visits weaken further over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next 14 days when RESIDENTIAL rises and TRANSIT falls in the same week.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS plunges by more than 10 points week-on-week after previously being near zero, the same mobility shock should spread to discretionary destinations and pull RETAIL_REC lower over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by more than 10 points week-on-week after a near-zero week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not underperform its prior 4-week mean in the month after the PARKS drop threshold is crossed.

mechanism_narrative: If both GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT keep falling for two weeks, the decline indicates broad mobility contraction rather than category reshuffling, and RETAIL_REC will be lower within one week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT both fall for 2 consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 7 days after both GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT have declined for two straight weeks.
